message: Hi! I want to try a jiu jitsu class for myself. Can I book a trial?
Hey! Absolutely, we'd love to have you try a class. I'm Emma from Gracie Farmington Valley. What's your name?
Hi Emma! I'm Tester Redwood. Nice to meet you!
Nice to meet you too, Tester! To get you set up for a free trial, can I grab your email?
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Last thing - what's your date of birth? This helps us match you with the right class.

Perfect! You'll be joining our Adult Fundamentals Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class.
Let me check some available times for your free trial. What days work best for you this week?
I'm flexible! I can do any day this week.

Great! Here are some open slots this week:

Tuesday 7/7 at 7:30 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 6:30 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 7:30 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 10:30 AM

Which time works best for you?
Let’s go with Tuesday 7/7 at 7:30 PM.

Perfect! You're all set for Tuesday, July 7th at 7:30 PM for your free Adult Fundamentals Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu trial class. We're located at 15 Cheryl Dr d in Canton. Just wear comfortable workout clothes and come ready to have fun! See you then!
